case: Russia–China eastern gas implementation and deferred western/PS2 bargaining
date_policy: Dates distinguish event and publication. Slash intervals denote known event/report windows, not continuous bargaining. Year/month-only observations retain that precision.
classification_policy: Policy texts, forecasts and operating observations are included as context or tests, not automatically coded as negotiating moves. A claimed binding instrument does not imply all commercial terms are settled.

moves.record_type: reported partial binding agreement and target

moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Final sale not signed until May 2014.
moves.inference_limit: Underlying agreement unavailable; leader attendance is not price agreement.
